props.kicker: Open source · Browser automation for email
props.title: Superhuman ==BrowserUse Pack==
props.subtitle: Your inbox, on autopilot — with a human still in charge.

slides.notes: Hook: Superhuman made reading email fast — this pack makes the repetitive parts run themselves. One sentence, then move.

props.title: Fast for a human. ==Slow for the routine.==

slides.notes: Superhuman wins on human speed, but the same routines — triage, nudges, filing — burn keyboard time every single day.

props.title: Browser Use automations that drive Superhuman ==the way you would.==
props.body: Clicking, reading, drafting — through the web app like a person — so routine inbox work becomes repeatable recipes.

slides.notes: No API hacking: the automations use Superhuman's web interface the way a person does, which keeps them robust and inspectable.

props.title: Every recipe is small, inspectable, and ==stops for you.==

items.title: Perform
items.body: Runs the routine, step by visible step

slides.notes: Walk the four beats. Emphasize the last two: drafting only, and a hard stop where the human takes over.

items.title: Drafts, not sends
items.body: Recipes prepare messages; nothing leaves your inbox on its own.

items.title: Visible steps
items.body: Every action happens on screen where you can watch it.

items.title: Human approval
items.body: Anything outbound needs a person to say yes first.

slides.notes: The trust slide: automation prepares, people decide. That's the design principle, not a setting.

props.title: A pack of ready-made inbox recipes.

tiles.title: Triage passes
tiles.body: Sort the day's mail by your rules, every morning.

tiles.title: Follow-up nudges
tiles.body: Find threads that went quiet and draft the nudge.

tiles.title: Auto-filing
tiles.body: File, label, and archive recurring mail on schedule.

tiles.title: Recurring checks
tiles.body: Watch for the messages you always end up hunting for.

tiles.title: Fully editable
tiles.body: Each recipe is small, readable code you can tweak.

slides.notes: Pick one or two recipes to demo live if there's time; the point is breadth — routine inbox work, covered.

props.kicker: Status — a working pack, open source
